title: Twilight
author: Stephenie Meyer
summary: Seventeen-year-old Bella moves to the rainy town of Forks, Washington, and becomes fascinated by a mysterious, distant classmate. She learns his family has a dangerous secret.
readIf: you want an intense, all-consuming teen romance with a supernatural twist.
skipIf: you want complex, grounded characters or dislike slow, brooding romance.

pairings.reason: A later, more adult romance in the same vein of a human girl drawn into a dangerous magical world.
A lighter, funnier teen romance with similar slow-burn longing.
A very different vampire novel that is far more serious and melancholy.
